ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping Safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The National and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The National and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

2. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.

3. B — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

4. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

5. C — Producers

6. A — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.

9. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.

10. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.

11. A — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

12. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
